import subprocess, re, os, itertools, binascii
bin='/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/meson/fuzzing/fuzz_variant_binary_byteswap'
# run variants of small payload sizes/types, report ASan read size and addr relation
base_types=[b'(ssn)',b'(ssq)',b'(ssx)',b'(nss)',b'(qss)',b'(sns)',b'(sqs)',b'(sxn)',b'(svv)',b'(oos)',b'(gng)',b'(ayay n)'.replace(b' ',b''),b'(aiai n)'.replace(b' ',b'')]
for t in base_types:
  for L in range(0,8):
    p='/tmp/probe'
    open(p,'wb').write(bytes([0])*L + b'\x00'+t)
    r=subprocess.run([bin,p],cwd='/workspace',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=2)
    out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
    m=re.search(r'READ of size (\d+)',out)
    if r.returncode and m:
      print(t,L,'read',m.group(1),'hex',binascii.hexlify(open(p,'rb').read()).decode())
